_about: Training Camp's team project under a name the client loads (2026-11-22: maps_dict 212's first match crashed both players at its load). The client cuts a project name to 31 characters; training-camp-teams-1's v010b_cs_training_camp/day_teams is 32, so the client looked for day_team, found no project config and crashed in create_game_objects (0x22C11E). This list copies day_teams' project, as training-camp-teams-1 leaves it, to day_tdm (30 characters) and points Team Deathmatch's config (212) and Freeze Tag's (450) at it. day_teams stays as players have it, named by no config (release/build_content.py's project name check refuses a longer name).
